decision.why: Smallest true reading of "automatic": resolves itself with no button, using the SAME rule the chip and needs/ already read, so it can never disagree with either. Caveat: most cards never had a formal Decision/Question at all, so most rows will read as 'resolved' by this rule — it marks 'nothing formally open', not 'nothing to look at'. If that reads as too broad once seen, the narrower fix is restricting it to cards that DID have at least one need and now have none (a one-line change in rules.js).
